subject: general
question: The international airport of which Indian city is named after Dr. B. R. Ambedkar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nagpur Airport**, also known **as Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport**, serves **Nagpur in Maharashtra state in India**.
 
• It was **named in 2005 **after **B. R. Ambedkar, Dr. "Babasaheb" Ambedkar**, the **chief architect of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• **Dr. B. R. Ambedkar:**
 
 
• B. R. Ambedkar was popularly known as **Babasaheb Ambedkar**.
 
• He was **one of the architects of **the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• He was a **very well-known political leader**, **eminent jurist**, **Buddhist activist**, **philosopher**, **anthropologist**, **historian**, **orator**, **writer**, **economist**, **scholar, **and **editor, **too.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Airports in Maharastra**:

 
 
• There **are 12 Airports in Maharastra**.

 
 
• Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport (BOM), Mumbai
 
• Pune International Airport (PNQ), Pune
 
• Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport (NAG), Nagpur
 
• Shri Guru Gobind Singh Ji Airport (NDC), Nanded
 
• Akola Airport (AKD)
 
• Aurangabad Airport (IXU)
 
• Shirdi Airport (SAG)
 
• Kolhapur Airport (KLH), Kolhapur
 
• Gandhinagar Airport 
 
• Solapur Airport 
 
• Jalgaon Airport
 
• Ozar Airport in Ozar
